name: Tiriel AI
long_description:
Tiriel is the AI workforce for freight dispatch.

Not dispatch software. A workforce: specialized AI agents, each with one job, one standard, and one boss, the dispatcher. Scout finds freight across 14+ load boards. Closer negotiates rates with brokers by phone, in parallel, within the rate floors you set. Coordinator manages your drivers in English, Spanish, or whatever language your fleet speaks. Auditor closes the paperwork, files detention and TONU claims, and processes PODs. Analyst learns your operation and makes the team better every week.

Every call is recorded, transcribed, and attached to the load. You direct. They execute.

Built by a family that has operated trucking companies for over 20 years. Live across the United States.

Start with $99 at https://tiriel.ai
one_liner: The AI workforce for freight dispatch
